title: No minimal internal neural correlate suffices for consciousness

statements.text: Consciousness depends on how brain dynamics are embedded in the somatic and environmental context of the animal’s life, so there may be no minimal internal neural correlate whose intrinsic properties suffice for conscious experience. The processes that matter for consciousness cut across brain, body and world.

sources.quote: there may be no such thing as a minimal internal neural correlate whose intrinsic properties are sufficient to produce conscious experience
